issue.title: Mark CSS gates hide ◐ progress marks, 🔓 glyphs, and Tasks date marks in Obsidian popout windows
issue.description:
Several bob-ledger-tools mark families gate visibility with a CSS rule keyed on a class that the
plugin adds only to the **main window's** `document.body`:

- `styles.css:1673` `body:not(.bob-progress-marks) .bob-progress-mark { display: none; }`
- `styles.css:1709` `body:not(.bob-unblocked-glyphs) .bob-unblocked-glyph { display: none; }`
- `styles.css:1322` `body:not(.bob-date-marks) .bob-date-mark[data-host="tasks"] { ... }`

The setup/toggle methods (`setupProgressMarks`, `setupUnblockedGlyph`, `setupDateMarks`, and their
`toggle*` twins in `src/266`, `src/268`, `src/271`) call `document.body.classList.add(...)` on the
main window only, and nothing in `src/*.js` listens for `workspace` `window-open` or touches a
popout's `win.doc.body` (grep for `window-open|activeDocument|.doc.body` finds nothing).

Obsidian injects plugin `styles.css` into popout windows, but a popout has its own `<body>`. Unless
Obsidian mirrors arbitrary plugin-added body classes into popouts (believed not to), every
`body:not(.bob-…)` gate matches there and hides the ◐ In Progress marks, the 🔓 unblocked glyphs,
and the Tasks-result date marks in any note opened in a popout window, even with the toggles on.

Found while designing Today marks (bob-ledger-tools), which avoid the pattern by gating on an
opt-out `body.bob-today-marks-off` class instead.

Suggested fix: invert each gate to an opt-out class (`body.bob-progress-marks-off …`) so the
default is visible everywhere, or mirror the toggle classes onto each popout body on
`workspace.on("window-open")` and on toggle.

task_type_fields.impact: Read-time marks silently disappear in popout windows only; low severity unless Bryan uses popouts.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-ledger-tools/styles.css:1322,1673,1709 and setup/toggle methods in src/266, src/268, src/271
task_type_fields.repro: Open today's daily note (with an In Progress Task Link under an open Pomodoro) in a popout window (right-click tab → Open in new window), confirm the ◐ mark shows in the main window but not in the popout; inspect the popout <body> classList for bob-progress-marks.

issue.creation_reason: Found while designing Today marks: the existing mark toggles add their gate class only to the main window body, so the body:not(...) CSS gates likely hide those marks in popout windows.
